17408.note: Softer, wheat-adjacent style of rye. Very drinkable.

17409.name: Bruichladdich Classic Laddie
17409.note: Unpeated, unusual for Islay. Fresh and coastal rather than smoky.

17412.name: Drumshanbo Single Pot Still Irish Whiskey
17412.note: From the Gunpowder Gin distillery. Well-regarded, spicy pot-still character.

17416.name: Roe And Co Irish Whiskey
17416.note: Diageo's modern Irish blend. Well-made and approachable, from the old Guinness distillery site.

17431.name: Redneck Riviera Whiskey
17431.note: Sweet and soft. Sold on the label, not the liquid.

17438.name: Southern Comfort 80
17438.note: Not bourbon and never was. Sweet fruit liqueur.

17450.name: Alberta Premium Rye Cask Strength
17450.note: Cask-strength 100% rye. One of the most acclaimed whiskies in the store, Canadian or otherwise.

17492.name: Patron Anejo Tequila Sherry Cask Aged
17492.note: Sherry-cask finish adds a fruitier, richer note than the standard Anejo.

17516.name: Reservoir Bourbon Whiskey
17516.note: Richmond's own craft bourbon. Solid and well-made, worth it for the Virginia flag alone.

17541.name: Connemara Peated Irish Whiskey
17541.note: A rare peated Irish whiskey -- genuinely distinctive if you like Scotch but want something different.

17553.name: Diplomatico Planas Rum
17553.note: Venezuela's well-regarded Diplomatico house, in an unaged white expression. Smoother than most white rums.

17573.name: Foursquare Probitas White Rum
17573.note: Blended pot-and-column-still white built for serious cocktails. A rum-nerd favorite.

17583.name: Marie Brizard Creme De Cacao Blanc
17583.note: A well-made clear creme de cacao, the standard for a Grasshopper or Brandy Alexander.

17617.name: Kavalan Distillery Select Whisky
17617.note: Taiwanese, not Japanese, despite the shelf placement -- but genuinely excellent. Tropical-climate aging gives it fast, fruit-forward maturity.

17690.name: Buffalo Trace Bourbon Cream
17690.note: A cream liqueur, not a bourbon. Good over ice or in coffee.

17694.name: Ciroc Mango Vodka
17694.note: Tropical mango on the smooth Ciroc base, well-balanced.

17704.name: Crossed Rifles Spiced Rum
17704.note: Virginia craft spiced rum, warm and balanced.

17724.name: Rebel 100
17724.note: Wheated at 100 proof for twenty-two dollars. Serviceable.

17738.name: Great Falls Gin
17738.note: Virginia craft gin. Competent and unremarkable — buy it for the Virginia flag, not to seek it out.

17765.name: Noble Oak Double Oak Bourbon
17765.note: Finished in a second, heavily charred barrel. Extra oak, not extra complexity.

17786.name: Tarnished Truth Ava Vodka
17786.note: Virginia craft distillery. Clean, well-made, worth trying for the Virginia flag.

17792.name: Very Old Barton 100 Proof
17792.note: Seventeen dollars for bonded bourbon. Rough edges, real value.

17823.name: Tequila Partida Blanco
17823.note: Clean, bright, estate-grown. Punches above thirty dollars.

17851.name: Sugarlands Mark & Diggers Rye Apple Moonshine
17851.note: Rye spice under the apple sweetness — more interesting than the straight apple pie flavors.

17853.name: Fernet Branca Liqueur
17853.note: Aggressively bitter and medicinal. You will know within one sip.

17855.name: Ezra Brooks 99 Proof
17855.note: Bold for the money. A decent well bourbon.

17927.name: Kill Devil Gold Rum
17927.note: Kill Devil's aged expression, a fair step up in character from the Silver.

17965.name: Thomas S. Moore Bourbon Cabernet Sauvignon Cask
17965.note: Wine-cask finished, one of several Thomas S. Moore variants here. Interesting more than essential -- the finish is doing most of the talking.

17968.name: Crystal Head Vodka Pride Bottle
17968.note: Dan Aykroyd's skull-bottle vodka. Smooth and unremarkable — you're paying for the bottle.

17977.name: Hornitos Tequila Anejo
17977.note: Pleasant añejo at a fair price.

17978.name: Bombay Sapphire Bramble Gin
17978.note: Blackberry Sapphire. Sweet and a bit thin.

17998.name: Kirk And Sweeney Reserva Rum
17998.note: Dominican, solid but unremarkable next to the bigger aged-rum names at this price.

18006.name: Deep Eddy Lime Vodka
18006.note: Real lime character, a genuine step up from the Smirnoff/Pinnacle flavored tier.

18031.name: Copper Dog Scotch Whiskey
18031.note: A blended malt (all single malts, no grain whisky) sourced from Speyside distilleries. More character than a standard blend.

18085.name: Barrell Seagrass Rye Whiskey
18085.note: Barrell's blended-rye approach, sourced from multiple distilleries. Distinctive, batch-dependent character.

18112.name: Laphroaig 10 Year Sherry Cask
18112.note: Sherry cask softens the peat slightly while adding richness. A great variant if the standard bottle is too austere.

18125.name: Mars Iwai Japanese Whisky
18125.note: Mars Shinshu's entry-level blend. A decent budget option, less refined than the bigger names.

18160.name: Cutwater Long Island Ice Tea
18160.note: A real multi-spirit base rather than a single neutral spirit -- noticeably better than jug versions.

18162.name: Cutwater Lime Margarita
18162.note: Cutwater's tequila-based margarita, well-balanced and one of the better canned versions.

18164.name: Cutwater Mai Tai
18164.note: More balanced and rum-forward than the Bacardi/Captain Morgan jug versions.

18178.name: Coastal Cocktails Cranberry Vodka 4pk
18178.note: Straightforward vodka cranberry in a can.

18183.name: Ole Smoky Sour Apple Moonshine
18183.note: Sour candy apple rather than pie spice. Different lane from their Apple Pie.

18184.name: Ole Smoky Sour Watermelon Moonshine
18184.note: Candy watermelon, sour rather than sweet.

18246.name: Empress 1908 Gin
18246.note: Butterfly pea flower turns it violet-blue; a splash of tonic turns it pink. Gimmick aside, the juniper holds up.

18253.name: Belle Isle Lemon Lavender Moonshine
18253.note: Floral and bright rather than candy-sweet. Distinctive among flavored moonshines.

18273.name: Whistlepig Farmstock Farmhouse Batch
18273.note: A blend across Whistlepig's Farmstock program. Decent, if less distinctive than their single-barrel releases.

18280.name: Captain Morgan Mai Tai
18280.note: Similar tier to the Bacardi jugs -- cheap, sweet, functional for a cookout.

18290.name: Vecchio Amaro Del Capo
18290.note: Calabrian amaro, bold and spiced. A favorite among bartenders.

18296.name: Whistlepig Farmstock Beyond Bonded Rye
18296.note: Whistlepig's bottled-in-bond Farmstock entry. Solid, if less distinctive than their single-barrel releases.

18323.name: Basil Hayden Toast Bourbon
18323.note: Finished for extra sweetness. Pleasant dessert pour, not a serious sipping upgrade.

18327.name: 1800 Ultimate Black Cherry Margarita
18327.note: Similar sweetness profile to the rest of the 1800 Ultimate line.

18330.name: Midnight Moon Watermelon Moonshine
18330.note: Candy watermelon on the smoother Midnight Moon base.

18331.name: Midnight Moon Lightning Lemonade Moonshine
18331.note: Tart lemonade, refreshing over ice in the summer.

18332.name: Ole Smoky White Chocolate Strawberry Cream
18332.note: White chocolate dominates over the strawberry. A dessert shot.

18390.name: El Tesoro Reposado Single Barrel
18390.note: A genuinely well-regarded artisanal tequila. Consistently excellent, agave character intact.

18403.name: Mars Iwai 45 Japanese Blended Whisky
18403.note: Higher proof than the standard Iwai. More backbone, still an entry-level blend.

18453.name: Selvarey Chocolate Rum
18453.note: Real cacao character from Selvarey. A novelty flavor done reasonably well.

18465.name: 99 Blue Raspberries
18465.note: Mini-only novelty shot. Tastes like the candy, not much else.

18478.name: Bumbu Creme
18478.note: Bumbu's cream liqueur variant. Sweet and dessert-like, a different lane from their spiced rum.

18505.name: Alberta Premium Rye
18505.note: 100% rye, unusually spicy and bold for the price. A cult favorite among whiskey people, and it's right here for fifteen dollars.

18563.name: Jameson Orange
18563.note: A flavored twist on the world's best-known Irish whiskey. Fine, not essential.

18566.name: 818 Tequila Blanco
18566.note: Sweet and soft. Sold entirely on the name.

18588.name: Western Son Blueberry Vodka
18588.note: Texas-made, real blueberry character rather than candy sweetness.

18594.name: Zacapa No. 23 Rum
18594.note: Guatemalan solera, sweet and syrupy. The rum most people mean when they say they like rum.

18595.name: Zacapa Edicion Negra Rum
18595.note: More balanced and less sweet than the No. 23. The better Zacapa if you can find the extra twenty-five dollars.

18598.name: Bold Rock Blue Ridge Mtn Rita
18598.note: Hard-cider-adjacent margarita from the Virginia cidery -- light and easy-drinking.

18639.name: Johnnie Walker High Rye Scotch
18639.note: A rye-grain-forward twist on the Johnnie Walker formula. Spicier than Black Label.

18642.name: Batch & Bottle Glenfiddich Scotch Manhattan
18642.note: Real Glenfiddich behind it. A genuinely different, whisky-forward Manhattan.

18644.name: Batch & Bottle Monkey Shoulder Lazy Old Fashioned
18644.note: Scotch-based Old Fashioned, a different profile from the usual bourbon/rye versions.

18645.name: Batch & Bottle Hendrick's Gin Martini
18645.note: Made with actual Hendrick's. Tastes like a real martini, not a gin-flavored cooler.

18674.name: South Mountain Distilling Moonarita Moonshine
18674.note: Pre-flavored for a margarita. Convenient, not distinctive.

18675.name: South Mountain Distilling Jbs 103 Moonshine
18675.note: Their higher-proof unflavored bottle. Honest and unrefined, as the name promises.

18676.name: South Mountain Distilling Cherry Bounce Moonshine
18676.note: A real Appalachian cherry-bounce recipe rather than candy cherry. More character than most fruit shines here.

18677.name: South Mountain Distillery Sin A Shine Moonshine
18677.note: Sweet fruit-forward shine, on par with the rest of the South Mountain line.

18680.name: Jb Raders Honeycrisp Apple Moonshine
18680.note: Honeycrisp apple flavor, sweet and easy-drinking.

18730.name: Broken Shed Vodka
18730.note: New Zealand whey-based vodka. Silky and well-reviewed, an interesting change of pace.

18742.name: Appleton Estate 15 Year
18742.note: Excellent aged Jamaican. Complex without losing the funk that makes Appleton distinctive.

18780.name: Jefferson's Ocean Rye
18780.note: The aged-at-sea treatment applied to rye. Interesting, if the gimmick matters less to you than the bourbon version.

18786.name: Flor De Cana Spresso
18786.note: Rum-based coffee liqueur from Flor de Cana. Distinct from the vodka-based competitors.

18788.name: Cutwater Pina Colada
18788.note: Genuinely creamy and coconut-forward, a fair canned pina colada.

18791.name: Cutwater Mango Margarita
18791.note: Sweet mango over the same solid Cutwater base.

18798.name: The Dalmore Sherry Cask 12 Year
18798.note: More sherry intensity than the standard 12 Year. Rich and full-bodied.

18818.name: Loyal 9 Lemonade And Iced Tea RTD
18818.note: Half-and-half format, same flavor profile as their standard lemonade.

18820.name: Loyal 9 Lemonade RTD
18820.note: A basic vodka lemonade, easy-drinking and unremarkable.

18853.name: Ole Smoky Banana Pudding Cream Moonshine
18853.note: Sweet and dessert-like. A Jell-O-shot flavor more than a sipper.

18855.name: Worthy Park 109 Dark Rum
18855.note: Jamaican pot-still funk at a higher proof. Distinctive and well-regarded among rum enthusiasts.

18902.name: Bulleit Manhattan Cocktail
18902.note: Bulleit rye gives it real spice. A dependable bottled Manhattan from a name you trust.

18903.name: Bulleit Old Fashioned Cocktail
18903.note: Same bones as their Manhattan. Solid, no surprises, does the job well.

18962.name: Ole Smoky Pineapples With Pina Colada
18962.note: Pina colada flavor, sweet and coconut-forward.

18971.name: Xicaru Silver Mezcal
18971.note: Straightforward espadín at a fair price.

18992.name: Bacardi Pineapple Mai Tai
18992.note: Pineapple-forward, sweet rather than balanced like a real Mai Tai.

19010.name: Citronge Orange
19010.note: A solid, mid-tier orange liqueur -- a fair Cointreau alternative for mixing.

19052.name: Brown Sugar Bourbon 103
19052.note: Cinnamon and brown sugar at 103 proof. Loud and sweet.

19053.name: Nikka Coffey Vodka
19053.note: From the Japanese whisky maker. Distinctly creamy and rich for a vodka.

19081.name: Ten To One Caribbean White Rum Blend
19081.note: A blend across five Caribbean islands. More character than a typical mixing white rum.

19094.name: Bo & Ivy Distillers Gin
19094.note: Perfectly decent, nothing to argue about.

19131.name: Tia Maria Cold Brew
19131.note: Jamaican coffee liqueur, lighter and less sweet than Kahlua.

19185.name: Nikka Yoichi Single Malt Whiskey
19185.note: Nikka's smokier, coastal single malt. Distinctive and highly regarded among Japanese whisky drinkers.

19187.name: Nikka Miyagikyo Single Malt Whisky
19187.note: Nikka's fruitier, more floral single malt (as opposed to Yoichi's smokier profile). Excellent and well-regarded.

19202.name: Belle Isle Blackberry Vanilla Moonshine
19202.note: Sweet dessert profile, blackberry more background than forward.

19291.name: Ole Smoky Pumpkin Spice Cream Moonshine
19291.note: Seasonal pumpkin spice, sweet and heavy on cinnamon.

19300.name: George Dickel Bourbon Whisky 8yr
19300.note: Dickel’s bourbon, eight years old, thirty dollars. Quietly excellent.

19314.name: Ole Smoky Some Beach Moonshine
19314.note: Tropical pineapple-coconut blend. A summer cooler flavor.

19330.name: Bacardi Hurricane Cocktails
19330.note: Same tier as the rest of the Bacardi cocktail jugs -- sweet, fruity, forgettable.

19339.name: Mount Gay Black Barrel Rum
19339.note: Bourbon-cask finished. More character than Eclipse for fifteen dollars more, and it shows.

19340.name: Flor De Cana Grand Reserve 7 Year Rum
19340.note: Nicaraguan, caramel-forward, reliably good. A safe sipping choice.

19341.name: Captain Morgan 100 Proof Original Spiced Rum
19341.note: The standard Captain Morgan spice profile at a higher, more assertive proof.

19343.name: Brugal Anejo Rum
19343.note: Dominican, light-bodied, easy. A step above well rum without costing much more.

19344.name: Brugal Extra Dry Rum
19344.note: A clean, light-bodied white rum, less sweet than most -- built for a Cuba Libre or mojito.

19345.name: Appleton Estate Rare Blend 12 Year Rum
19345.note: Complex, dried-fruit-and-spice Jamaican. One of the better bottles in the store at any price.

19347.name: Noilly Prat Sweet Vermouth
19347.note: Solid everyday sweet vermouth at a third of Carpano’s price.

19354.name: Grey Goose Essences White Peach & Rosemary Vodka
19354.note: Grey Goose's lower-sugar Essences line. More sophisticated than the classic flavored expressions.

19356.name: Grey Goose Essences Strawberry & Lemongrass Vodka
19356.note: Bright, herbal, and less sweet than a typical flavored vodka. Well-balanced.

19371.name: Stagg Bourbon
19371.note: Uncut, unfiltered, and intense. A genuine cult release that happens to still show up on shelves occasionally.

19374.name: Pikesville 110 Proof Rye Whiskey
19374.note: Maryland-style, bottled at 110 proof. A cult favorite that still shows up on shelves at a fair price.

19377.name: Knob Creek 12 Year Bourbon
19377.note: More age and depth than the standard Knob Creek, at a fair premium for it.

19383.name: Nikka Coffey Grain Japanese Whisky
19383.note: Sweet, vanilla, unusual. Very good neat, if you can justify seventy dollars.

19385.name: Nikka Pure Malt Japanese Whisky
19385.note: Nikka's blended-malt bottle, the black-label version. Solid and well-liked.

19388.name: Umiki Japanese Whisky
19388.note: A budget blend with mixed reception. Fine for the price, not a category standout.

19390.name: Tullamore Dew 12 Irish Whiskey
19390.note: Tullamore Dew's aged premium expression. More depth and complexity than the standard bottle.

19391.name: The Irishman Single Malt Irish Whiskey
19391.note: A solid, well-reviewed single malt from a smaller Irish producer.

19392.name: Knappogue Castle 12 Year Single Malt Irish Whiskey
19392.note: A genuinely well-aged single malt at a fair price for the category.

19394.name: Bushmills 12 Year Single Malt Irish Whiskey
19394.note: More sherry-cask depth than the 10 Year. One of the better values in aged Irish single malt.

19398.name: Wild Turkey Kentucky Spirit Bourbon
19398.note: Wild Turkey's single-barrel expression. Higher proof and more character than the standard 101.

19399.name: Widow Jane 10 Year Straight Bourbon Whiskey
19399.note: Sourced but well-aged and well-chosen. A fair step up from their standard bottling.

19400.name: Whistlepig 6 Year Piggyback Rye Whiskey
19400.note: 100% rye, Vermont-finished. Younger and cheaper than the 10 Year, most of the character intact.

19406.name: The Singleton Of Glendullan 15 Year Scotch
19406.note: More depth and complexity than the standard bottle. A fair step up.

19407.name: The Singleton Of Glendullan Scotch
19407.note: A smooth, approachable entry-level Singleton. Fine, unremarkable.

19408.name: The Macallan Double Cask 12 Year Scotch
19408.note: A blend of sherry-seasoned American and European oak. Excellent, and one of the more attainable Macallans.

19416.name: The Macallan Sherry Oak 12 Year Scotch
19416.note: Macallan's classic sherry-forward style. Rich, excellent, and worth seeking out at a fair price.

19421.name: The Glenrothes Bourbon Cask Reserve Scotch
19421.note: Lighter and sweeter than their sherry-cask expressions, from a well-regarded Speyside distillery.

19423.name: The Glenlivet French Oak Reserve 15 Year Scotch
19423.note: French oak gives it a spicier profile than the standard Glenlivet line.

19424.name: The Glenlivet Founders Reserve Scotch
19424.note: Glenlivet's entry-level bottle. Smooth, floral, a reliable Speyside standard.

19425.name: The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve Scotch
19425.note: Rum-cask finished, sweeter and lighter than the Founders Reserve.

19427.name: The Dalmore 12 Year
19427.note: Rich, orange-and-sherry character. A well-regarded, distinctive Highland malt.

19439.name: Oban Distillers Edition Scotch
19439.note: Montilla-cask finished, richer than the standard 14 Year. Well-regarded.

19445.name: Laphroaig Single Malt Scotch
19445.note: The classic Laphroaig 10 Year profile -- intensely smoky and medicinal, love-it-or-hate-it.

19446.name: Laphroaig Quarter Cask Scotch
19446.note: Iodine, smoke and seaweed, bottled at higher strength. Divisive and brilliant.

19447.name: Laphroaig Lore Scotch
19447.note: A blend of some of Laphroaig's oldest stocks. Deep, complex, and well-regarded among peat fans.

19450.name: Laphroaig 10 Year Cask Strength Scotch
19450.note: The standard 10 Year at full proof. Even more intense smoke and peat.

19452.name: Lagavulin Single Malt Scotch
19452.note: The 16-year. The great smoky scotch — expensive and worth it once.

19459.name: Highland Park 15 Year Scotch
19459.note: More depth than the standard 12 Year, keeps the distinctive honey-and-heather Orkney character.

19461.name: Haig & Haig Pinch Scotch
19461.note: A historic blend in a distinctive pinched bottle. Smooth and traditional.

19462.name: Glenmorangie The Original 18 Year Scotch
19462.note: A genuine step up in depth and complexity from the 10 and 12 Year expressions.

19463.name: Glenmorangie The Original 10 Year Scotch
19463.note: One of the lightest, most approachable Highland malts. A good gateway into single malt Scotch.

19483.name: Ardbeg Wee Beastie Scotch
19483.note: Ardbeg's youngest official release. Punchy and peaty despite the young age.

19489.name: Ardbeg An Oa Scotch
19489.note: A gentler, more balanced Ardbeg than the standard Ten -- still distinctly smoky.

19514.name: Rittenhouse Rye Private Barrel
19514.note: Rittenhouse from a single barrel. Same excellence, slightly more varied.

19524.name: Hatozaki Sm Batch Whisky 12 Yr Umeshu Cask Finish
19524.note: Plum-wine cask finish gives it a sweet, unusual profile. A novelty pour more than a classic sipping whisky.

19543.name: Wild Turkey Rare Breed Rye
19543.note: Barrel-proof, no two batches identical. Excellent value for cask-strength rye.

19544.name: Bushmills Peaky Blinders Irish Whiskey
19544.note: A TV tie-in bottling of standard-tier Bushmills. Decent whiskey riding a licensing deal.

19545.name: Suntory Yamazaki 12 Year Japanese Whisky
19545.note: The benchmark Japanese single malt. Consistently excellent, and the price reflects genuine, sustained demand rather than hype.

19553.name: Hill Top Blackberry Gooch Hooch Moonshine
19553.note: Blackberry moonshine at a premium price for the category — flavor doesn't quite justify the jump.

19581.name: Rossville Union Barrel Proof Rye Whiskey
19581.note: MGP-sourced, cask strength. A well-loved value among barrel-proof rye drinkers.

19601.name: Western Son Lemon Vodka
19601.note: Clean and citrus-forward, a solid mixer.

19617.name: Oban Scotch 10yr
19617.note: A coastal Highland malt balancing smoke and sweetness. Consistently excellent.

19627.name: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Reposado Tequila
19627.note: Decent, and a world away from Especial.

19677.name: Citadelle Jardin d'Été
19677.note: Stone fruit version. Nice, but the standard Citadelle is the better bottle.

19679.name: Nikka Coffey Malt Japanese Whisky
19679.note: Malted barley run through a Coffey still -- a genuinely distinct texture from a traditional pot-still single malt.

19680.name: Luxardo Aperitivo Spritz
19680.note: Real Italian aperitivo character, less syrupy than the domestic canned spritzes.

19681.name: Luxardo Bitter Bianco Spritz
19681.note: A lighter, less bitter spritz than the Aperitivo version. Good gateway spritz.

19686.name: Bold Rock Vodka Orange Crush
19686.note: A Virginia-Beach-boardwalk classic in a can. Sweet, easy, does the job.

19698.name: Dekuyper Peachtree Schnapps PET
19698.note: Same peach schnapps as the glass bottle, plastic for the cookout cooler.

19715.name: Pineapple Upside Down Cake Moonshine
19715.note: Sweet and caramelized, tastes like the cake. A dessert pour.

19716.name: Pattis Peach Pie Moonshine
19716.note: Peach pie flavor in the crowded dessert-moonshine field. Fine, not distinctive.

19717.name: Pennys Pecan Pie Moonshine
19717.note: Pecan pie flavor — one of the more unusual dessert shines on the shelf.

19727.name: Waterman Spirits Organic Vodka
19727.note: Virginia-made, organic, and genuinely clean. A good local option for an everyday vodka.

19757.name: Chopin Family Reserve Vodka
19757.note: Chopin's top bottling, aged in oak. The most distinctive potato vodka in the store.

19760.name: Mezcal De Leyendas Oaxaca Espadin
19760.note: From a respected small-batch mezcal producer. Traditional, well-made, worth seeking out.

19788.name: Tenjaku Blended Japanese Whisky
19788.note: An approachable, budget-friendly rice-forward blend. A fair entry point into Japanese whisky.

19819.name: Cutwater White Russian
19819.note: Cutwater's vodka base makes this a decent canned White Russian -- creamy without being cloying.

19825.name: Pinhook Kentucky Straight Bourbon
19825.note: Sourced but well chosen and consistently bottled. A safe pick in the thirty-five dollar range.

19838.name: The Dalmore 14 Year
19838.note: More depth and complexity than the 12 Year, a genuine step up.

19850.name: Waterman Spirits Orange Organic Vodka
19850.note: Same clean Waterman base with orange flavor added.

19864.name: Shoe Crazy Broken Heel Mango Moonshine

19865.name: Blue Chair Bay Mocha Rum Cream
19865.note: Coffee-forward, smooth. Consistent quality with the rest of the Blue Chair Bay line.

19881.name: Shoe Crazy Broken Heel Coffee Moonshine
19881.note: Coffee-flavored shine, sweet rather than bitter.

19891.name: Remy Martin XO Excellence
19891.note: Remy's XO tier. Silky and rich, built for sipping neat.

19906.name: Cutwater Black Skimmer Rye
19906.note: Competent, a little thin for thirty dollars.

19955.name: Torabhaig Allt Gleann Single Malt Scotch
19955.note: A newer Skye distillery. Peaty and well-made, worth trying if you like Talisker.

19973.name: Chocolat Deluxe Triple Chocolate Liqueur
19973.note: Rich and genuinely chocolatey. A dessert liqueur, not built for mixing.

19998.name: Sombra Mezcal Artesanal Joven
19998.note: Clean, bright, less smoke than most.

20021.name: Powers Johns Lane Irish Whiskey
20021.note: Serious pot still whiskey. A big step up from the gold label.

20022.name: The Sexton Irish Whiskey
20022.note: Sherry-cask matured single malt, smooth and approachable.

20032.name: Uncle Nearest Straight Rye Whiskey
20032.note: From the team that built Uncle Nearest 1856. Well-made, well-reviewed, worth the price.

20036.name: New Amsterdam Pink Whitney Vodka
20036.note: The viral pink lemonade flavor. Sweet and tart, does exactly what the internet made it famous for.

20069.name: 99 Grapes Schnapps
20069.note: Purple candy in a bottle. Does the one job it has.

20070.name: 99 Coconut Schnapps
20070.note: Actually reads as coconut rather than generic sweet. Fine in a shot round.

20110.name: Oban 14 Year Scotch
20110.note: Coastal and honeyed. Good, priced high.

20113.name: Whistlepig Farmstock - Statestock VA Edition
20113.note: A regional Whistlepig release. Distinctive and worth seeking out for that alone.

20166.name: Malfy Gin Con Limone
20166.note: Lemon-forward and easy. Basically a head start on a tom collins.

20199.name: Los Siete Misterios Doba Yej Mezcal
20199.note: Rustic and characterful. For someone already sold on mezcal.

20201.name: Corazon Tequila Reposado
20201.note: Good value reposado at twenty dollars.

20202.name: Proper No. Twelve Irish Apple
20202.note: Conor McGregor's brand, apple-flavored variant. Sweet and simple.

20213.name: Ciroc Honey Melon Vodka
20213.note: Sweet melon flavor, consistent with the rest of the Ciroc line.

20216.name: Don Julio Tequila Reposado Rosado
20216.note: Finished in wine casks for color and a fruitier edge. A novelty variant on a reliable base.

20241.name: On The Rocks The Espresso Martini
20241.note: One of the more reliable widely-available bottled espresso martinis.

20242.name: On The Rocks The Manhattan
20242.note: Similar quality tier to their Old Fashioned -- solid and consistent.

20253.name: Belle Isle Blood Orange & Soda Cocktail
20253.note: Light, low-sugar, and refreshing -- a good session option.

20254.name: Belle Isle Ruby Red & Soda Cocktail
20254.note: Similar light, low-sugar profile to the Blood Orange version.

20255.name: Belle Isle Honey Habanero & Pineapple Cocktail
20255.note: Real heat behind the sweetness -- more interesting than most canned tropical drinks.

20256.name: Belle Isle Cold Brew Coffee Moonshine
20256.note: Coffee liqueur dressed as moonshine. Fine over ice, not distinctive.

20261.name: Bols Peach Liqueur
20261.note: Dutch liqueur house, noticeably more balanced than the Dekuyper/Arrow tier of peach schnapps.

20266.name: Delola Spritz Lorange
20266.note: Orange-forward and easy-drinking. Solid warm-weather option.

20267.name: Delola Spritz Bella Berry
20267.note: Kyle Richards' spritz line. Fruity and easy-drinking, more approachable than assertive.

20268.name: Delola Spritz Paloma Rosa
20268.note: Grapefruit-forward, refreshing, similar tier to the rest of the Delola line.

20280.name: Five Trail Blended American Whiskey
20280.note: Jon Pardi's blend of bourbon, rye and single malt. Better than most celebrity whiskey.

20281.name: Coastal Cocktails Blackberry Bramble 4pk
20281.note: A decent Virginia-made canned cocktail, fruity and balanced.

20282.name: Jura 10 Yr. Scotch
20282.note: Light and approachable island malt, easy entry point into Jura.

20285.name: Belle Isle Transfusion 4pk
20285.note: A grape-and-ginger-ale classic done well in a can.

20301.name: Chi Chis Cosmopolitan
20301.note: Budget party jug, sweet and thin -- interchangeable with the rest of the Chi-Chi's line.

20302.name: Chi Chis Long Island Iced Tea
20302.note: Bottom-shelf party jug. Cheap, sweet, gets the job done for a crowd.

20303.name: Chi Chis Margarita 4 Pack
20303.note: The canned 4-pack version of their standard margarita. Same budget-jug flavor, more portable format.

20304.name: Chi Chis Pina Colada
20304.note: A bottom-shelf canned pina colada. Sweet and coconut-forward, functional for a poolside drink.

20305.name: Chi Chis Pineapple Margarita
20305.note: Tropical fruit variant on their standard margarita jug. Same budget tier.

20306.name: Chi Chis Pink Lemonade Margarita
20306.note: Tastes more like spiked pink lemonade than a real margarita, same as the rest of the Chi-Chi's line.

20308.name: Chi Chis Margarita
20308.note: Same tier as the rest of the Chi-Chi's line -- a budget party jug.

20309.name: Chi Chis Peach Margarita
20309.note: Bottom-shelf bottled margarita. Cheap and sweet, nothing more.

20310.name: Chi Chis Ruby Red Margarita
20310.note: Grapefruit-tinted variant on the standard formula. Cheap and functional for a crowd.

20312.name: Penelope Bourbon Four Grain
20312.note: Four-grain blend, honeyed and approachable. Popular for a reason.

20316.name: The Busker Triple Cask Irish Whiskey
20316.note: A well-priced, approachable blend. A fair everyday Irish whiskey.

20326.name: Denizen Vatted Dark Rum
20326.note: A blend of Jamaican and Martinique rums built specifically for a proper Mai Tai.

20372.name: Suntory World Whisky Ao
20372.note: A blend across five whisky-producing nations -- an interesting concept that is decent rather than exceptional in the glass.

20373.name: Virago Spirits Classic White Rum
20373.note: Virginia craft white rum. Clean and unremarkable, worth trying for the local angle.

20389.name: Rittenhouse Rye
20389.note: Bonded 100-proof rye for twenty-four dollars. The best cocktail whiskey in the store, full stop.

20423.name: Blue Run High Rye Bourbon Whiskey
20423.note: A newer, heavily-hyped brand that mostly backs it up -- spicy and well-made, if priced for the hype.

20432.name: Benchmark Single Barrel
20432.note: Pleasant and inoffensive. Varies barrel to barrel.

20434.name: Sauza Tres Generaciones Cristalino
20434.note: A solid, unremarkable cristalino. Fine for the price, not a standout.

20444.name: Gran Centenario Cristalino
20444.note: A solid mid-tier cristalino, unremarkable but reliable.

20447.name: Benchmark Bonded
20447.note: Bonded Buffalo Trace-adjacent bourbon for twenty-two dollars. Better than Benchmark No. 8.

20448.name: Benchmark Full Proof
20448.note: 125 proof from the Buffalo Trace mashbill for twenty-five dollars. Loud and cheap.

20466.name: Maggies Farm Spiced Rum
20466.note: Pittsburgh craft spiced rum, real character beyond generic vanilla-spice.

20469.name: Jack Daniels Single Barrel Rye Barrel Proof
20469.note: Jack Daniel's rye at cask strength. More character than their standard offerings, worth trying if you assume Jack Daniel's can't do rye well.

20474.name: Black Bull 12 Yr Scotch
20474.note: A high-malt-content blend, more character than a standard blend at this price.

20475.name: Montelobos Ensamble Mezcal
20475.note: A well-regarded blended mezcal, balances smoke with real agave sweetness.

20480.name: Heaven Hill Bottled In Bond Bourbon
20480.note: 100 proof, 4 years minimum, government-audited. About as much bourbon as you can buy per dollar.

20503.name: Astral Tequila Reposado
20503.note: Soft and easy. Good margarita base.

20512.name: Old Parr 18 Year Scotch
20512.note: A well-aged premium blend, smoother and richer than the 12 Year.

20553.name: Green River Kentucky Bourbon
20553.note: Newer Kentucky distillery finding its feet. Decent.

20554.name: Grand Mayan Reposado
20554.note: Same story as the Silver -- the bottle is doing a lot of the selling.

20572.name: Lairds Old Fashioned Apple Brandy Cocktail
20572.note: An apple brandy Old Fashioned from an actual apple brandy house -- distinctive and well made.

20581.name: Woodinville Straight Bourbon Whiskey
20581.note: Washington state, grain grown and distilled on-site. Genuinely well made, not just a marketing story.

20583.name: Woodinville Straight Rye Whiskey
20583.note: 100% rye mashbill, grain-to-glass in Washington. Big, spicy, well made.

20584.name: Kopper Kettle Bonded Rye
20584.note: Virginia bonded rye. Solid local pour.

20589.name: Stellum Rye
20589.note: 116 proof, uncut. A lot of whiskey for thirty dollars.

20590.name: Stellum Bourbon
20590.note: Uncut at 116 proof for thirty dollars. Blended from good stock; add water.

20603.name: Grey Goose Classic Martini Rts
20603.note: Genuinely well-proportioned, a real gin-and-vermouth-adjacent martini rather than a sweetened cocktail.

20619.name: Equiano Light Rum
20619.note: A blend of Mauritian and Caribbean rums with a genuine social mission behind the brand. Clean and versatile.

20638.name: Arrow Butterscotch Schnapps
20638.note: Cheaper and thinner than Dekuyper Buttershots. Gets the job done in a pinch.

20644.name: Belvedere Organic Vodka
20644.note: Belvedere's rye base with an organic certification. Clean and smooth, a genuine step up.

20685.name: On The Rocks The Old Fashioned
20685.note: A dependable bottled Old Fashioned, real bourbon behind it, widely available.

20686.name: On The Rocks The Cosmopolitan
20686.note: A fair bottled cosmo, balanced rather than syrup-sweet.

20687.name: On The Rocks The Margarita
20687.note: On The Rocks generally uses real name-brand spirits -- one of the better mainstream bottled margaritas.

20712.name: Suntory Toki Japanese Whisky
20712.note: Light and clean. Built for highballs, priced above its weight.

20713.name: Yamazaki 12 Yr 100th Anniversary Limited Edition
20713.note: Same benchmark Yamazaki 12 Year inside a limited-edition package. Excellent whisky, collector pricing.

20716.name: Oakside Cocktail Rye Old Fashioned
20716.note: Genuinely bar-quality bottled Old Fashioned. A fair price for what it delivers.

20717.name: Oakside Cocktail Negroni
20717.note: A real Negroni bitterness, not dumbed down for a wider audience.

20718.name: Oakside Cocktail Manhattan
20718.note: Balanced and boozy rather than sweet -- one of the better bottled Manhattans available.

20740.name: Whistlepig 10 Year Single Barrel Rye
20740.note: Vermont-finished Canadian rye, single barrel. Excellent, if pricey for the category.

20767.name: Ketel One Espresso Martini Cocktail
20767.note: One of the better bottled espresso martinis -- Ketel One's vodka keeps it from tasting like syrup.

20774.name: Ketel One Cosmopolitan Cocktail
20774.note: Balanced and not overly sweet, a fair bottled cosmo.

20853.name: Cutwater Margarita Variety 12 Pack
20853.note: A good way to sample the Cutwater margarita flavors without committing to one.

20854.name: Writers Tears Red Head
20854.note: Sherry-cask matured, richer and fruitier than the standard Copper Pot.

20856.name: Cutwater Black Skimmer Bourbon
20856.note: San Diego craft, sourced Midwest juice. Fine, unremarkable, priced like it knows that too.

20878.name: Old Forester Single Barrel Barrel Proof
20878.note: Old Forester's single-barrel picks are consistently among the best barrel-proof values available.

20915.name: J J Corry The Gael Irish Whiskey
20915.note: An independent bottler blend, well-regarded among Irish whiskey enthusiasts.

20917.name: Dr. Stoners Ginger Whiskey Lemonade RTD
20917.note: Whiskey-based rather than vodka, gives it a bit more character than the average canned lemonade.

20921.name: Templeton Rye Barrel Strength
20921.note: More intensity than the standard Templeton bottle, a fair step up for the price.

20950.name: Powers Rye Irish Whiskey
20950.note: A rye-heavy pot-still whiskey, spicier and more distinctive than a standard blend.

20957.name: Zing Zang Blazing Bloody Mary Rts Cocktail
20957.note: Spicier version of their standard Bloody Mary, real heat rather than just black pepper.

20959.name: London No. 1 Gin
20959.note: The blue bottle gin. Juniper-forward and better than the novelty packaging suggests.

20966.name: Pussers Rum Painkiller RTD 4pk
20966.note: Pusser's actual navy rum in the classic Painkiller formula. A cut above the typical canned tiki drink.

20974.name: Zing Zang Bloody Mary Rts Cocktail
20974.note: A genuinely well-regarded Bloody Mary mix pre-mixed with vodka. Better tomato character than most canned versions.

21064.name: Empress 1908 Elderflower Rose Gin
21064.note: Empress with elderflower and rose folded in. Pleasant, but a niche pour next to the original.

21100.name: Green River Wheated
21100.note: Soft wheated pour. Pleasant, not memorable.

21102.name: Bardstown Bourbon Company Origin Series - Rye
21102.note: Bardstown's house style applied to rye. Solid, consistent, a fair every-day pour.

21144.name: Hakushu 12 Year Japanese Whisky
21144.note: Green, forested, and distinctive -- one of the defining Japanese single malts. Superb, and priced accordingly.

21193.name: Blackened Rye - The Lightning 2024 Edition
21193.note: Metallica-branded, sonically-enhanced marketing aside. A decent rye riding on the novelty as much as the liquid.

21198.name: Handy & Schiller Manhattan
21198.note: Same careful approach as their Old Fashioned. One of the best bottled Manhattans on this shelf.

21200.name: Traveller Whiskey Blend #40
21200.note: Chris Stapleton's blend with Buffalo Trace. Smooth and well-made — better than the celebrity tie-in suggests.

21201.name: Handy & Schiller Old Fashioned
21201.note: Barrel-finished, actually tastes like a bar-made Old Fashioned rather than a syrupy RTD.

21222.name: Hibiki Japanese Harmony Whisky 100th Anniversary
21222.note: The same excellent Harmony liquid in commemorative packaging. Buy it for the whisky, not the box.

21245.name: Ole Smoky Bourbon Ball Cream
21245.note: Similar concept to the 1792 version, sweeter and less bourbon-forward.

21263.name: Willett Pot Still Reserve Straight Bourbon
21263.note: Sourced, but the pot-still character Willett adds makes it distinctive rather than generic.

21265.name: Willett Family Estate 4 Yr Rye Whiskey
21265.note: Willett's distinctive pot-still character applied to rye. Well-regarded among collectors.

21304.name: Woodinville Straight Rye Single Barrel Program
21304.note: A single-barrel pick of Woodinville's already-excellent 100% rye. Big and well-made.

21311.name: Highland Park Cask Strength Single Malt Scotch
21311.note: Full-proof Orkney malt -- honeyed and lightly peated, more intense than the standard 12 Year.

21331.name: Ten To One Caribbean Dark Rum Blend
21331.note: Same multi-island blending approach as their white, aged for more depth.

21335.name: Navy Hill Tequila Soda Blood Orange
21335.note: Low-sugar tequila soda, a good option if the sweet margarita cans are too much.

21336.name: Navy Hill Tequila Soda Grapefruit
21336.note: Grapefruit variant, consistent quality with the rest of the lineup.

21337.name: Navy Hill Tequila Soda Hint Of Lime
21337.note: Same clean, low-sugar approach as the rest of the Navy Hill line.

21348.name: Crown Royal Single Malt
21348.note: Canada's answer to a single malt. Different animal from the blends — worth trying once.

21356.name: 10-42: End Of Watch Bourbon Whiskey
21356.note: Virginia, law-enforcement themed with a charitable angle. Decent bourbon, buy it for the cause as much as the pour.

21362.name: St. Elder Blood Orange Liqueur
21362.note: St. Elder's citrus variant, bright and well-balanced.

21373.name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Scotch Sherry Finish
21373.note: A sherry-finished variant on the standard 12 Year, slightly richer.

21374.name: Tullamore Dew Irish Whiskey - Honey
21374.note: A honeyed variant on the standard Tullamore Dew. Sweet and approachable.

21426.name: Don Julio 70 Cristalino
21426.note: Smooth and versatile, a genuinely good gateway into cristalino tequila.

21443.name: On The Rocks The Strawberry Daiquiri
21443.note: Sweet and fruity, a fine poolside pour without much rum character.

21465.name: Glenmorangie Scotch Tale Of Tokyo
21465.note: A limited Japanese-inspired finish -- distinctive, priced for the novelty as much as the whisky.

21479.name: Dingle Vodka
21479.note: Irish craft vodka. Clean and well-made, priced for the craft-distillery premium.

21484.name: On The Rocks Blue Hawaiian
21484.note: Bright blue novelty tiki drink. Sweet, does the job for a beach theme.

21490.name: Angostura 5 Year Superior Rum
21490.note: Trinidad, balanced and easy-drinking. Made by the bitters people.

21492.name: Knob Creek Rye 10 Year
21492.note: A genuine age-stated step up from standard Knob Creek Rye. Excellent value for the depth it adds.

21523.name: Lagavulin Offerman 11yr Caribbean Rum Cask Scotch
21523.note: Nick Offerman's rum-cask collaboration. Genuinely well-made, not just a celebrity tie-in.

21545.name: El Silencio Mezcal Black (espadin)
21545.note: Approachable and smoky. The black bottle.

21577.name: Midnight Moon Moonshake Cookies And Cream
21577.note: Reads like the cookie, milky-sweet. A novelty dessert shot.

21586.name: Grand Mayan Triple Distilled Silver Tequila
21586.note: A decorative hand-painted bottle carries a lot of the price. Decent tequila underneath, not a standout.

21618.name: George Dickel Bottled In Bond Tenn Whiskey 12 Year
21618.note: Twelve years, bonded, forty-five dollars. One of the best deals in the store.

21622.name: Planteray Original Dark Rum
21622.note: A dependable dark rum from the same house as the 5 Year. Rich without being overly sweet.

21626.name: Planteray Xaymaca Special Dry Rum
21626.note: Funky Jamaican pot-still rum built for tiki. Punchier than most rum at this price.

21654.name: Weller Antique Single Barrel Select
21654.note: A single-barrel pick of the Weller Antique 107 recipe. Reliable, if you can find it at this price.

21660.name: Mijenta Tequila Blanco
21660.note: Additive-free and beautifully made. The best blanco on this shelf.

21689.name: Patron Anejo Cristalino
21689.note: Patron's cristalino treatment on their Anejo. Smoother and lighter than the standard bottle.

21705.name: Ole Smoky Key Lime Moonshine Cream
21705.note: Tart-and-sweet key lime pie in a bottle. Better balanced than most of their cream line.

21710.name: High West Bottled In Bond Rye
21710.note: A genuinely well-made bottled-in-bond entry from a distillery known for its rye blends.

21724.name: 400 Conejos Mezcal Joven
21724.note: Entry-level mezcal. Smoky, a bit rough.

21727.name: Lincoln Ridge Vodka
21727.note: Virginia craft vodka, competent but not distinctive.

21753.name: On The Rocks Carbonated Mango Mint Mojito
21753.note: Fruity mojito twist, refreshing over ice.

21755.name: On The Rocks Carbonated Cucumber Lemongrass Mule
21755.note: A refreshing, less-sweet take on the canned mule format.

21774.name: Cutwater Espresso Martini
21774.note: A reliable, widely available canned espresso martini -- real coffee character.

21797.name: Sugarlands Banana Pudding Sippin Cream
21797.note: Sugarlands' cream line is a genuine step up from their flavored shine — this one nails banana pudding.

21798.name: Sugarlands Butter Pecan Sippin Cream
21798.note: Rich and nutty, one of the better cream shines on the shelf.

21799.name: Sugarlands Chocolate Coffee Sippin Cream
21799.note: Mocha-forward, sweet enough to work as an after-dinner pour.

21800.name: Sugarlands Orange Dream Sippin Cream
21800.note: Creamsicle in a bottle. Tastes exactly like the popsicle.

21803.name: Ragged Branch Signature Bourbon Bottled In Bond
21803.note: Virginia's bottled-in-bond entry. Grain-to-glass, solid, and the Virginia flag is a real bonus here.

21817.name: Ardbeg Spectacular Single Malt Scotch
21817.note: A limited annual release, well-regarded but priced for the scarcity as much as the liquid.

21863.name: Basil Hayden Dark Rye
21863.note: Blended with port and California red wine. Sweet and polarizing rather than a straight rye.

21864.name: Basil Hayden Bourbon
21864.note: Light-bodied and low proof for the price. Easy to drink, easy to outgrow.

21865.name: Basil Hayden 10 Year Bourbon
21865.note: More depth and age than the standard Basil Hayden, which was always a bit thin for the price.

21872.name: Belle Isle Lemon Drop
21872.note: Belle Isle's real moonshine base makes this a cut above the typical canned lemon drop.

21914.name: Larceny Private Barrel
21914.note: Single-barrel Larceny at 92 proof. Better than the standard bottle when you find it.

21933.name: Buzzballz Chili Mango Cocktail
21933.note: One of the more distinctive flavors in the lineup -- real chili heat behind the mango sweetness.

21936.name: Buzzballz Cran Blaster Cocktail
21936.note: Tart cranberry, one of the less cloying flavors in the lineup.

21937.name: Buzzballz Forbidden Apple Cocktail
21937.note: Candy apple flavor, straightforward and sweet.

21938.name: Buzzballz Tequila Rita Cocktail
21938.note: Same tier as the rest of the line -- more sugar than tequila character, but reliably potent.

21939.name: Buzzballz Strawberry Rita Cocktail
21939.note: The archetypal BuzzBallz flavor -- sweet, potent, and fine for exactly what it is: a party ball, not a cocktail.

21940.name: Buzzballz Choc Tease Cocktail
21940.note: Chocolate-cream flavor, dessert-like rather than a classic cocktail.

21941.name: Buzzballz Peachballz Cocktail
21941.note: Straightforward peach flavor, one of the more popular flavors in the lineup.

21942.name: Buzzballz Lotta Colada Cocktail
21942.note: Sweet coconut-pineapple, same value tier as the rest of the line.

21943.name: Buzzballz Watermelon Smash Cocktail
21943.note: Candy watermelon flavor, consistent with the rest of the fruit-forward lineup.

21944.name: Buzzballz Espresso Martini Cocktail
21944.note: Sweeter and less coffee-forward than the craft bottled versions, but cheap and convenient.

21949.name: W L Weller Special Reserve
21949.note: Wheated and soft. Genuinely hard to find at shelf price — take it if the count says any.

21950.name: Carolans Peanut Butter
21950.note: A novelty flavor that mostly delivers on the concept -- sweet and rich.

21972.name: Belle Isle Aged Honey Habanero Moonshine
21972.note: Barrel-aged version of the Honey Habanero. Rounder, less harsh, worth the upgrade.

21980.name: Karahiyo Espresso Martini RTD
21980.note: Virginia-made espresso martini, solid coffee flavor.

21986.name: Buzzballz Pineapple Jalapeno Cocktail
21986.note: Real heat behind the pineapple sweetness -- one of the more distinctive flavors here.

21987.name: Buzzballz Horchata Cocktail
21987.note: Genuinely tastes like horchata. One of the more distinctive flavors in the BuzzBallz lineup.

21991.name: Highlands Dragon Navy Strength
21991.note: 114 proof. Stands up to strong mixers and doesn't vanish in a negroni.

22005.name: On The Rocks Hornitos Margarita PET
22005.note: A real Hornitos tequila base in a convenient single-serve bottle.

22006.name: Old Elk Rye Whiskey Single Barrel
22006.note: A well-regarded craft single barrel. Consistently good, if pricier than the Kentucky mass brands.

22016.name: Buchanans Pineapple
22016.note: A flavored novelty variant. Sweet and simple, not aimed at whisky purists.

22032.name: Very Old Barton 80
22032.note: Cheap and passable. The 100 proof is the one to get.

22046.name: Hatozaki Finest Blended Whiskey With Glass
22046.note: A well-regarded budget-premium Japanese blend. Balanced and easy-drinking.

22051.name: Balvenie Single Malt Scotch 14 Yr Bourbon Barrel
22051.note: A single-cask bourbon-barrel expression. Lighter and more vanilla-forward.

22110.name: Buzzballz Hazelnut Latte Cocktail
22110.note: A coffee-and-cream flavor, sweeter than a real latte but pleasant as a dessert ball.

22115.name: Pennsylvania Dutch Salted Caramel Cream
22115.note: A budget-tier salted caramel cream, fine for the price.

22120.name: Sagamore Small Batch Rye Whiskey
22120.note: Maryland-style, a blend of high- and low-rye mashbills. Well regarded, balanced spice.

22140.name: Kahlua Chocolate Sips
22140.note: Kahlua's chocolate variant. Sweet and dessert-like, less versatile than the original.

22141.name: Kahlua White Chocolate Sips
22141.note: White chocolate and coffee combination, sweeter than standard Kahlua.

22187.name: Crown Royal Whisky Sour Cocktail Black Cherry
22187.note: Fruity and easy-drinking, not trying to be a classic sour.

22193.name: Crown Royal Reserve 12yr
22193.note: More oak and depth than the base bottle. A real step up for the extra twenty-two dollars.

22224.name: Midnight Moon Peppermint With 2 Shot Glasses
22224.note: Holiday peppermint shine, comes with shot glasses for the gift angle.

22225.name: Speyburn Bourbon Cask
22225.note: A fair value Speyside, sweeter and lighter from the bourbon-cask maturation.

22256.name: Black Tot Finest Caribbean Rum
22256.note: A tribute blend to the old Royal Navy tot. Rich and historic, priced like it.

22259.name: High West Manhattan Barrel Finished Cocktail
22259.note: High West's actual whiskey behind the mix, not a neutral base. One of the stronger bottled Manhattans.

22302.name: Belle Isle Ginger Ginger Moonshine
22302.note: Real ginger bite. Good base for a moonshine mule.

22311.name: 1792 Barton Chocolate Bourbon Ball Cream Liqueur
22311.note: A genuine bourbon behind the chocolate-cream flavor. Tastes like the candy, in a good way.

22317.name: Cutwater Lemon Drop Martini
22317.note: Balanced citrus, one of the more drinkable canned lemon drops.

22349.name: Ole Smoky Chocolate Peanut Butter Cream Moonshine
22349.note: Rich and sweet, a dessert pour over ice.

22354.name: Penelope Estate Collection Private Select Bourbon
22354.note: One of dozens of Penelope private-barrel picks on the shelf. Decent, but quality varies more than the flagship line.

22382.name: Astral Ready To Serve Margarita Cocktail
22382.note: Astral is a real, well-regarded tequila -- this punches above the typical bottled margarita.

22399.name: Fore Craft Cocktails Transfusion RTD 4 Pk
22399.note: A fair canned transfusion, grape and ginger ale balance is decent.

22401.name: Angels Envy Kentucky Straight Bourbon Triple Oak
22401.note: Angel's Envy's finished bourbon, three cask types. More complex than their standard port-finished bottle.

22417.name: Uncle Vals Zested Gin
22417.note: Uncle Val's with extra citrus zest. Fine in a gin and tonic, unremarkable neat.

22422.name: Buzzballz Pumpkin Cocktail
22422.note: Seasonal pumpkin spice, sweet and appropriately autumnal.

22476.name: On The Rocks The Lemon Drop Martini
22476.note: Tart and sweet in the right proportion, better than most bottled lemon drops.

22477.name: Redwood Empire Devils Tower High Rye Bourbon
22477.note: Technically a high-rye bourbon that ABC files here for the mashbill. Solid and well-made.

22500.name: Old Ezra 7 Year Rye Single Barrel
22500.note: A well-aged single barrel at a fair price. Consistently good.

22515.name: Absolut Cocktails Espresso Martini
22515.note: Solid mid-tier bottled espresso martini, a step below the craft options but reliable.

22516.name: Absolut Cocktails Classic Cosmopolitan
22516.note: A fine everyday cosmo, nothing that stands out.

22549.name: The Copper Can Peach Mule
22549.note: Peach and ginger combination, a fair seasonal variant.

22563.name: Jameson Triple Triple
22563.note: Triple distilled, triple cask matured -- a genuine step up from standard Jameson.

22590.name: New Riff Bottled In Bond Bourbon
22590.note: High-rye, no chill filtration, bottled in bond. The cult favorite on this list for a reason.

22623.name: Glenmorangie The Original 12 Year Scotch
22623.note: More depth than the 10 Year, still recognizably light and floral.

22628.name: New Riff Bottled In Bond Rye
22628.note: Same distillery, same integrity as their bourbon. One of the best ryes on the shelf at any price.

22653.name: Hibiki Harmony Japanese Whisky
22653.note: An iconic, beautifully balanced blend in one of the most recognizable bottles in whisky. Worth it whenever it is not marked up for scarcity.

22654.name: Kikori Japanese Whisky
22654.note: Rice whisky rather than malt or grain in the Scotch sense. Smooth and mixable, a different lane entirely.

22656.name: Midnight Moon Moonshake Peanut Butter Cup
22656.note: Candy-bar sweet. Same lane as Ole Smoky Buckeye.

22657.name: Penelope Wheated Bourbon
22657.note: Soft and approachable, sourced juice with Penelope's finishing touch. A gentler wheater than Maker's.

22658.name: Hatozaki Small Batch Japanese Whisky
22658.note: A step up from Hatozaki's Finest bottle. More balanced and complex.

22681.name: El Tequileno Reposado
22681.note: A cult bottle for twenty-five dollars. Rich, cooked-agave, genuinely excellent.

22789.name: High West Cask Strength Barrel Select Whiskey
22789.note: Cask-strength High West blend. Bold and well-regarded among whiskey enthusiasts.

22804.name: Open Road Distilling Maple Old Fashioned
22804.note: Virginia craft distillery, maple sweetness is prominent but not overwhelming.

22805.name: Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey Tequila Cask
22805.note: An unusual tequila-cask finish on a well-regarded single malt base. Distinctive.

22807.name: Flecha Azul Cristalino
22807.note: A celebrity-backed brand (Mark Wahlberg). Fine tequila, riding more on the name than the liquid.

22823.name: Lairds American Mule
22823.note: Laird's apple brandy gives this mule real depth beyond straight vodka or whiskey versions.

22846.name: Greenalls London Dry Gin
22846.note: Honest, unfussy London dry. Nothing to complain about.

22860.name: The Macallan A Night On Earth - Jerez 2024
22860.note: A limited annual release, sherry-focused. Good, though priced for the packaging and scarcity as much as the liquid.

22870.name: Buzzballz Berry Cherry Limeade
22870.note: Standard BuzzBallz sweetness, berry and lime flavor comes through clearly.

22897.name: Blind Preacher Small Batch Rye
22897.note: Virginia craft rye. Solid, unremarkable next to the bigger regional names.

22911.name: Casamigos Margarita Variety Pack
22911.note: Single-serve cans of the same good tequila base. Convenient for a cookout.

22913.name: Yellowstone Cocktails Espresso -rts
22913.note: Bourbon-adjacent branding aside, this is a genuinely well-made bottled espresso martini.

22914.name: Yellowstone Cocktails Gold Rush -rts
22914.note: Honey and lemon over bourbon. Simple and it works.

22915.name: Yellowstone Cocktails Old Fashioned Rts
22915.note: A real bourbon base gives it more backbone than most bottled Old Fashioneds at this price.

22917.name: Foursquare Convocation Rum
22917.note: Foursquare's Exceptional Cask Series. As good as Barbados rum gets; priced for the serious collector.

22945.name: Tamnavulin Sherry Cask
22945.note: Sherry cask gives it more richness than the Double Cask version.

22957.name: Tamnavulin Double Cask
22957.note: A light, fruity, easy-drinking Speyside at a fair price.

22966.name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Scotch American Oak
22966.note: The world's best-selling single malt for a reason. Light, fruity, and reliably good.

23005.name: Olmeca Altos Classic Lime Margarita
23005.note: A genuine agave-forward tequila margarita, a step above the syrupy mass brands.

23006.name: Olmeca Altos Strawberry Margarita
23006.note: Same solid tequila base with strawberry sweetness added.

23012.name: Midnight Bean Espresso Martini
23012.note: Decent mass-market espresso martini, sweeter than the craft options.

23028.name: Waterman Spirits Strawberry Organic Vodka
23028.note: Real strawberry character, consistent with the rest of the Waterman line.

23076.name: Yamazaki Distillers Reserve
23076.note: No age statement, but this is the most accessible way onto the legendary Yamazaki name. Genuinely excellent.

23077.name: Jim Beam US Soccer Label
23077.note: White label with a different sticker. Same whiskey.

23091.name: Waterman Spirits Organic Grapefruit Vodka
23091.note: Tart grapefruit on the Waterman organic base -- refreshing.

23160.name: Breckenridge Cognac Cask Finished Whiskey
23160.note: Cognac-cask finish adds fruit and richness. A solid gift bottle.

23161.name: Patron Citronge Orange
23161.note: Tequila brand's orange liqueur. Fine in a margarita, not distinctive on its own.

23165.name: Skyy Infusions Espresso Vodka
23165.note: Decent coffee flavor, similar tier to Deep Eddy Espresso.

23166.name: Jose Cuervo Authentic Double Strength Margarita
23166.note: More alcohol than the standard Authentic line, still mostly sour-mix flavor.

23181.name: Koval Rye Bottled In Bond
23181.note: Chicago craft, 100% rye mashbill. Distinctive grain-forward flavor, different from the Kentucky style.

23199.name: Bold Rock Vodka Bay Crush
23199.note: Same easy-drinking crush format, different fruit profile.

23247.name: Kahlua Dunkin Caramel Swirl Cream
23247.note: A Dunkin' collaboration -- coffee and caramel, sweet and easy-drinking.

23264.name: Dewars 18 Japanese Mizunara
23264.note: Finished in Japanese mizunara oak -- a distinctive twist on the 18 Year.

23267.name: Ketel One Cocktails Lemon Drop Martini
23267.note: Balanced citrus and vodka, a fair bottled lemon drop.

23268.name: Bulleit Whiskey Sour Cocktail
23268.note: A fair bottled Whiskey Sour, more balanced than most of the cheaper competition.

23269.name: Buzzballz Lemon Tea Cocktail
23269.note: An Arnold Palmer-adjacent flavor, refreshing by BuzzBallz standards.

23270.name: Buzzballz Passionfruit Martini Cocktail
23270.note: A fruity martini-style ball, sweet and tropical rather than a classic martini profile.

23271.name: Buzzballz Strawberry Rita Americana
23271.note: Patriotic packaging on their reliable Strawberry Rita flavor.

23281.name: Tequila Ocho Barrel Proof Reposado
23281.note: A cult favorite among tequila enthusiasts. Full proof, full agave character.

23334.name: Penelope Cocktails Black Walnut Old Fashioned
23334.note: An unusual, nutty spin on the Old Fashioned. Distinctive among the bottled versions.

23338.name: Via Carota Craft Cocktail Espresso Martini
23338.note: Real espresso bitterness instead of coffee-liqueur sweetness. A cut above the mass-market versions.

23339.name: Via Carota Craft Cocktail Old Fashioned
23339.note: From the NYC restaurant's cocktail program. Polished and well-balanced.

23350.name: Opihr Spiced London Dry Gin
23350.note: Cardamom, cubeb pepper, black pepper. Warm and spiced — a good winter gin.

23366.name: Torres 20 Brandy
23366.note: Twenty years in sherry casks. Rich and complex — Spain's answer to XO cognac.

23369.name: Buzzballz Biggies Witchs Potion
23369.note: A Halloween large-format flavor, fruity and brightly colored. Novelty over nuance, as always with this line.

23374.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Cookie Nookie
23374.note: Cookies-and-cream flavor, a dessert ball rather than a mixed drink.

23375.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Eggnog
23375.note: A seasonal eggnog ball. Sweet and rich, fine for a holiday party.

23384.name: St. Brendans Espresso Irish Cream
23384.note: Coffee-forward twist on their standard cream. Works well over ice or in coffee.

23386.name: St. Brendans Salted Caramel Irish Cream
23386.note: Sweet and dessert-like, a fine seasonal pour.

23415.name: Rebel Butter Pecan Cream Liquer
23415.note: Sweet and nutty, a fair dessert liqueur.

23429.name: Buzzballz Biggies Peppermint Bark
23429.note: A large-format holiday flavor. Genuinely tastes like peppermint bark, sweet enough for dessert.

23445.name: Aviation Gin (gift set)
23445.note: Same gin as standard Aviation, with a scarf. Pay for the gin, not the scarf.

23447.name: Buchanans Green Seal 21 Year Blended Scotch
23447.note: One of the older, more refined Buchanan's expressions. Rich and well-aged.

23458.name: Highland Park 12 YR Old Single Malt Scotch
23458.note: Heather-honey with a wisp of smoke. Beautifully balanced, and sixty dollars.

23477.name: Penelope Cocktails Apple Cinnamon Old Fashioned
23477.note: Penelope's actual bourbon gives this real depth beyond the apple-cinnamon flavoring.

23486.name: Bardstown Bourbon Collaborative Ferrand
23486.note: A genuine collaboration with a French cognac house. One of the more ambitious blends on the shelf.

23493.name: Devils Due Distillery Candy Cane Moonshine
23493.note: Seasonal peppermint-candy shine. A holiday novelty, not a year-round pour.

23510.name: Ryans Salted Caramel Irish Cream
23510.note: Ryan's budget-tier cream with a caramel flavor. Fine for the price.

23513.name: Buzzballz Elf Maple Syrup Sundae
23513.note: A holiday dessert flavor -- maple and cream, sweet as the name suggests.

23518.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Grapes Gone Wild
23518.note: Candy grape flavor, straightforward and sweet.

23534.name: Boyd & Blair Blood Orange Cosmo
23534.note: Tart and citrus-forward, less cloying than most bottled cosmos.

23547.name: Suntory Toki Black Japanese Whisky
23547.note: A smokier, more assertive variant of standard Toki. Worth the small step up if you find Toki thin.

23584.name: Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Rye
23584.note: Elijah Craig's cult barrel-proof bourbon program extended to rye. Just as well-regarded.

23625.name: The Copper Can Huckleberry Mule
23625.note: Fruity twist on their standard mule, sweeter than the original.

23631.name: Ferrand Dry Curacao
23631.note: A richer orange liqueur than Cointreau. Excellent in a sidecar.

23632.name: Ferrand 1840 Cognac
23632.note: Made for cocktails and excellent in them. The thinking sazerac.

23657.name: El Condor Grapefruit Lime Margarita
23657.note: A budget option, decent for the price but not distinctive.

23663.name: On The Rocks The Tequila Espresso Martini
23663.note: An unusual tequila twist on the espresso martini formula. Works better than it sounds.

23733.name: Wyoming Whiskey Outryder Whiskey
23733.note: A blend of bourbons from a well-regarded craft distillery. Rich and worth the price.

23735.name: Boyd & Blair The Espresso Martini
23735.note: Made with an actual craft vodka base rather than a neutral filler. Noticeably smoother.

23757.name: On The Rocks Passion Fruit Margarita
23757.note: Tropical fruit variant on their standard formula.

23759.name: Shottys Green Tea Shot
23759.note: Sweet citrus-and-whiskey flavor rather than actual green tea. A party staple regardless.

23763.name: Buzzballz Pink Lemonsqueezy
23763.note: Pink lemonade flavor, tart and sweet in the usual BuzzBallz proportion.

23794.name: Mcconnells Sherry Cask Finished Irish Whiskey
23794.note: A revived historic Belfast brand. Solid sherry-finished blend.

23806.name: Shottys Lemon Drop Shots Vodka
23806.note: Tart and sweet, a functional party shot.

23808.name: Glenlivet 12 Year Jamaican Cask Single Malt Scotch
23808.note: A novelty rum-cask finish on the 12 Year -- distinctive, if a departure from a classic Glenlivet.

23822.name: Cutwater Pineapple Margarita
23822.note: Tropical fruit variant, consistent with the rest of the Cutwater margarita line.

23833.name: Aviation Cranberry & Blood Orange
23833.note: A flavored spinoff. Skip it and buy the standard bottle.

23842.name: Kelt Cognac Cask Strength
23842.note: Barrel-proof cognac, unusual for the category. Bold and intense.

23845.name: Castarede VSOP Armagnac
23845.note: Armagnac is rougher and more rustic than cognac — this is a great entry point.

23862.name: J. P. Wisers 15 Year Blended Canadian Whisky
23862.note: Fifteen years in the bottle for sixty dollars. Genuinely excellent value for aged Canadian whisky.

23891.name: Belle Isle Mango Tangerine Moonshine
23891.note: Tropical and sweet, straightforward fruit shine.

23902.name: Catoctin Creek Shenandoah Pink Gin
23902.note: Rose-tinted and floral. Pleasant, less serious than the Watershed.

23911.name: Mozart Strawberry Cream Liqueur
23911.note: From the Mozart chocolate liqueur house. Well-made, genuinely tastes like strawberries and cream.

23977.name: Evan Williams Blackberry
23977.note: Sweet blackberry. Not a whiskey decision.

24031.name: On The Rocks Sparkling Watermelon Margarita
24031.note: Sweet and fruity, fine for a poolside can.

24032.name: Hochstadters Slow & Low Maple Old Fashioned
24032.note: Maple leans sweet but the rye backbone keeps it from tipping into syrup.

24034.name: Hochstadters Slow & Low Cherry Old Fashioned
24034.note: Rye-based, real bitters character. A reliable pick from the bottled Old Fashioned field.

24047.name: Ole Smoky Mandarin Moonshine
24047.note: Bright citrus, less cloying than some of their fruit flavors.

24072.name: Lot No. 40 Canadian Rye Whisky
24072.note: 100% rye, bold and spicy. The best Canadian whisky on the shelf.

24103.name: Buzzbox Perfect Margarita
24103.note: A juice-box format margarita. Convenient and sweet, not a serious tequila drink.

24107.name: Buzzballz Berry Cherry Limeade Cocktail 4 Pack
24107.note: The can 4-pack version of their berry cherry limeade ball. Same sweet, potent formula, more convenient format.

24108.name: Buzzbox Vodka Lemonade
24108.note: Simple and sweet vodka lemonade in the same juice-box format.

24114.name: Pike Creek 10 Year Canadian Whisky
24114.note: Rum-cask finished, a little sweeter and rounder than standard Crown Royal. Underrated.

24125.name: Planteray Barbados 5 Year Rum
24125.note: Formerly Plantation. A well-regarded, versatile aged rum -- excellent both neat and in cocktails.

24127.name: On The Rocks Sparkling Lime Margarita
24127.note: Carbonated version of their standard margarita, lighter and more sessionable.

24145.name: Benchmark Rye
24145.note: 100 proof for seventeen dollars. Rough but honest.

24147.name: Traveller Full Proof Whiskey
24147.note: Barrel-proof version of the Stapleton blend. Bolder and more interesting than the standard bottling.

24172.name: Redbreast Lustau Edition Irish Whiskey
24172.note: Redbreast finished in genuine Lustau sherry casks. One of the best pot-still whiskeys available at any price.

24173.name: Johnnie Walker Black Cask
24173.note: A double-cask-matured take on Black Label. More depth than the standard bottle.

24186.name: Casamigos Classic Lime Margarita
24186.note: Real Casamigos tequila behind it -- noticeably better tequila character than the mass-market bottled margaritas.

24187.name: Casamigos Spicy Margarita
24187.note: Same quality tequila base with real jalapeno heat, not an artificial burn.

24220.name: Basil Hayden Golden Rye
24220.note: Finished with a touch of corn whiskey for sweetness. Same polarizing sweetness as Dark Rye.

24224.name: Diplomatico Mantuano
24224.note: Venezuelan, sweet and rounded — a crowd-pleaser more than a connoisseur's pour.

24240.name: Bib & Tucker 10 Year Small Batch Bourbon
24240.note: A genuine ten-year age statement at a fair price for it. Smooth and well-balanced.

24244.name: New Amsterdam Vodka 100 Proof
24244.note: A higher-proof version of the standard New Amsterdam. Clean and a bit more assertive.

24257.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Evergreen Variety Pack
24257.note: A holiday-season mixed pack. Same value tier as any individual flavor, just bundled.

24268.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Bent Banana
24268.note: Straightforward banana candy flavor, one of the simpler entries in the lineup.

24269.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Tropical Fruit Punch
24269.note: A fruit-punch flavor built for a cookout. Does the job.

24286.name: Buzzballz Americana Variety Pack
24286.note: A mixed pack of the standard flavors in patriotic packaging. Same value tier as any individual ball.

24297.name: Boatyard Gin
24297.note: Irish, botanicals foraged from the Erne estuary. Competent, not essential.

24307.name: Jagermeister Orange
24307.note: Standard Jager with orange citrus added. A shot-bar variant more than a sipper.

24309.name: Buzzballz Goaaaaaal-melon Vodka Cocktail
24309.note: A soccer-themed melon mini. Basic flavor, marketing-driven naming.

24311.name: Buzzballz Fuego Tamarita Vodka Cocktail
24311.note: A spicy tamarind-margarita mini can. More novelty than a serious margarita.

24312.name: Buzzballz Pip Pip Punch Vodka Cocktail
24312.note: A British-themed mini punch flavor. Basic fruit sweetness under the novelty name.

24313.name: Buzzballz Flags & Freedom Vodka Cocktail
24313.note: A patriotic-themed mini can, basic fruit-punch flavor.

24314.name: Buzzballz Sol Siesta Vodka Cocktail
24314.note: A tropical-themed mini can, sweet and simple.

24315.name: Buzzballz Smashentina Vodka Cocktail
24315.note: A fruity mini can with a playful name. Standard sweetness, nothing distinctive.

24316.name: Buzzballz Caipi Crush Vodka Cocktail
24316.note: A mini-can take on a caipirinha. Sweeter and less lime-forward than the real thing, but cheap and potent.

24317.name: Buzzballz Tropical Fruit Punch Beach Ball Cocktail
24317.note: A large-format beach-themed tropical punch. Same formula, bigger bottle.

24318.name: Handy & Schiller Paper Plane
24318.note: A well-executed bottled version of the modern classic -- bitter, balanced, not oversweetened.

24323.name: Engine Gin
24323.note: Italian, organic, sold in a motor-oil can. Light and citrusy; the can is half the appeal.

24379.name: Belle Isle Rocket Pop
24379.note: A novelty red-white-and-blue popsicle flavor -- fun for a summer cookout.

24384.name: Belle Isle Dill Pickle Moonshine
24384.note: Pickle-brine gimmick. Genuinely tastes like a dill pickle — a novelty, not a sipper.

24399.name: Highlands Distilling Dragon Virginia Vodka
24399.note: Virginia craft vodka, competent everyday quality.

24401.name: Ole Smoky White Lightnin Moonshine
24401.note: Their high-proof unflavored bottle. Rough, as advertised — closer to the old moonshine reputation.

24405.name: Ole Smoky Moonshine Lemon Drop
24405.note: Tart lemon candy. Works well over ice with a splash of soda.

24426.name: Penelope Riviera Cask Finish
24426.note: Cognac-and-rum cask finished blend. Sweet and approachable.

24433.name: Deep Eddy Espresso Vodka
24433.note: Real coffee character, useful for a quick espresso martini.

24466.name: Apervita Aperitivio
24466.note: A lighter, sweeter aperitivo-style liqueur, easy to mix into a spritz.

24510.name: Umiki Godzilla Whisky
24510.note: A novelty collector bottle riding the Godzilla branding. The packaging premium far outweighs what is in the glass.

24511.name: Worthy Park Estate Overproof Jamaica Rum
24511.note: Full Jamaican pot-still funk at overproof strength. Intense, built for a serious rum drinker or a real Jamaican punch.

24539.name: Dos Hombres Blanco Tequila
24539.note: Decent. You are paying for the television show.

24549.name: Virginia Distillery Co. Whisky Cherry Bounce
24549.note: A real Virginia single malt behind a cherry-forward cocktail. Distinctive regional option.

24550.name: Virginia Distillery Co. Whisky Espresso Martini
24550.note: Made with Virginia Distillery Co.'s own whisky rather than a neutral base. A cut above average.

24551.name: Murlarkey Perfect Old Fashioned Rtd
24551.note: Virginia distillery, real bourbon base. A solid regional bottled Old Fashioned.

24552.name: Murlarkey Smoked Old Fashioned Rtd
24552.note: Smoked twist on their standard Old Fashioned -- more interesting than most bottled versions.

24567.name: Hennessy VS Cocktails Henny Berry
24567.note: Cognac base gives it a bit more depth than the average canned cocktail.

24568.name: Hennessy VS Cocktails Henny Rita
24568.note: A cognac-margarita crossover. Interesting more than essential.

24576.name: Atheling Gin
24576.note: Virginia craft gin. Drinkable, not distinctive against the bigger contemporary bottles here.

24578.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Hole In Fun
24578.note: A donut-themed dessert flavor. Novelty first, cocktail second.

24579.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Fuzzy Melon
24579.note: A basic melon flavor, unremarkable even by BuzzBallz standards.

24580.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Paddle Punch
24580.note: A fruit-punch flavor in the same lane as their Tropical Fruit Punch ball.

24620.name: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Blanco Tequila
24620.note: The real Cuervo — 100% agave, unlike the gold. Fine and cheap.

24628.name: Penelope Cocktails Blackberry Old Fashioned
24628.note: Fruity twist on their Old Fashioned line, sweeter than the classic.

24638.name: Kaiyo 5 Wood Japanese Whisky
24638.note: Aged across five cask types including mizunara oak. Young but genuinely interesting for the price.

24646.name: Belle Isle Spiced Apple Moonshine
24646.note: Apple pie in a bottle, on the sweeter end even for this category.

24684.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Tropical Tang
24684.note: Tart tropical citrus, one of the brighter-tasting flavors in the lineup.

24691.name: Planteray Stiggins Fancy Pineapple Rum
24691.note: Genuine pineapple character built into an aged rum base rather than added as syrup.

24696.name: Cutwater Banana Mudslide
24696.note: Dessert-like and sweet, a fair canned mudslide.

24697.name: Dixie Southern Vodka Virginia Edition
24697.note: A Virginia-specific bottling, clean and unremarkable.

24704.name: The Glenlivet Provence
24704.note: Rose-wine cask finished. Distinctive and floral, a departure from the classic Glenlivet profile.

24725.name: Dewars Double Double Aged 21 Year Blended Scotch
24725.note: Double-matured for extra depth. One of the more distinctive premium blends.

24737.name: Buzzballz Variety Tailgate Pack
24737.note: A mixed pack aimed at tailgating. Same value tier as any individual ball, bundled for a crowd.

24739.name: Buzzballz Boulders Strawberry Rita
24739.note: The big-format jug version of their Strawberry Rita ball. Same flavor, built for a crowd.

24749.name: Lairds 13 Year Old Apple Brandy
24749.note: American apple brandy, aged well past the usual bottlings. The high end of a category most people don’t know exists.

24793.name: Waterloo No. 9 Gin
24793.note: Austin, Texas. Lavender and pecan, gentle.

24797.name: Waterloo Barrel Aged Gin
24797.note: Texas gin rested in oak. Amber-colored, whiskey-adjacent — a gin for whiskey drinkers.

24806.name: Carolans Strawberries & Cream Irish Cream
24806.note: Fruity twist on their standard formula, pleasant but not distinctive.

24859.name: Cruzan Island Reserve Rum 13 Year
24859.note: A genuinely aged, well-reviewed rum from a brand better known for flavored bottles.

24863.name: Bulleit 87 Blended Whiskey
24863.note: Lighter and thinner than Bulleit's bourbon. A step down from the brand's usual quality.

24877.name: High Horns Blended Scotch Whiskey
24877.note: A budget blend, unremarkable but functional.

24882.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Frosted Brown Sugar Cinnamon
24882.note: A holiday-spice flavor, cinnamon-forward and sweet.

24883.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Frosted Smores
24883.note: Genuinely tastes like the campfire treat. A sweet dessert ball rather than a cocktail.

24884.name: Buzzballz Cocktails Sugarplum
24884.note: A holiday-season fruit flavor, sweet and seasonal.

24903.name: Buzzballz Frankentini
24903.note: A Halloween-themed martini-style ball. Sweeter and less complex than a real martini, as expected.

24911.name: Coastal Cocktails Cucumber Collins 4pk
24911.note: Light and refreshing, a fair summer session can.

24958.name: Caravedo Puro Quebranta Pisco ( Peru)
24958.note: Peruvian pisco, clean and grape-forward. The real thing for a proper pisco sour.

24974.name: Hill Top Distillery Lemon Drop Moonshine
24974.note: Tart lemon candy flavor, priced like a step above the mass brands without tasting like one.

24981.name: Four Roses Bourbon 100 Proof
24981.note: The yellow label with the volume turned up. Floral, high-rye, very good.

24982.name: Aperol Spritz Ready To Serve Cocktail
24982.note: The real Aperol behind it, pre-mixed with prosecco and soda. Convenient and true to the original.

24999.name: Beluga Noble Vodka
24999.note: Russian, milk-thistle filtered. A genuine step up in texture from the mass brands.

25003.name: Powers Gold Label Irish Whiskey
25003.note: Spicier and more characterful than Jameson, and usually cheaper.

25015.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Dirty Shirley
25015.note: A canned take on the viral Dirty Shirley. Sweet, cherry-forward, does the trend justice for the price.

25023.name: Boondocks 6 Year
25023.note: Six-year age statement at thirty dollars. Fair.

25034.name: Buzzballz Cocktail Vampires Blood
25034.note: A Halloween red-fruit-punch flavor. Novelty branding, standard BuzzBallz sweetness underneath.

25073.name: Belle Isle Moonshine Cream
25073.note: Belle Isle's cream entry. Smoother than Ole Smoky's cream line, less cloying.

25126.name: Cape Charles Vodka( Do)
25126.note: Coastal Virginia craft vodka, clean and well-made.

25223.name: Crown Royal Salted Caramel Old Fashioned
25223.note: Sweeter and more dessert-like than a classic Old Fashioned, but well made for what it is.
